environment.description: Terraform provider binary runs as terraform-provider-custom_v1.2.3 in the Terraform plugin directory on a CI/CD runner (Ubuntu 22.04). Process runs as 'terraform' user with write access to /var/log/provider.log and /etc/cron.d/. Network egress is unrestricted. The log file is consumed by a log aggregation agent (Filebeat) that parses structured log lines and forwards to Elasticsearch, where injected CRLF entries can trigger alert suppression or forge audit entries.
